description: This file defines core interfaces and classes for representing and walking parse trees in the ANTLR parsing framework, including Tree, SyntaxTree, ParseTree, RuleNode, TerminalNode, ErrorNode, visitors, listeners, and tree walkers.

classes.name: Tree
classes.description: Basic interface for all tree nodes, providing methods for parent, children, and payload access.

classes.name: SyntaxTree
classes.description: Extends Tree with source interval information.

classes.name: ParseTree
classes.description: Extends SyntaxTree with methods for accepting visitors and getting text representations.

classes.name: RuleNode
classes.description: Represents a parse rule node with access to its rule context.

classes.name: TerminalNode
classes.description: Represents a terminal node with access to its token symbol.

classes.name: ErrorNode
classes.description: Represents an error node, a special terminal node for error recovery.

classes.name: ParseTreeVisitor
classes.description: Interface for visitors traversing parse trees.

classes.name: ParseTreeListener
classes.description: Interface for listeners reacting to parse tree traversal events.

classes.name: ParseTreeWalker
classes.description: Class implementing depth-first traversal of parse trees with event callbacks.

classes.name: IterativeParseTreeWalker
classes.description: Class implementing iterative (non-recursive) traversal of parse trees.

methods.name: Walk
methods.description: Performs a depth-first walk on a parse tree, invoking listener methods.

methods.name: EnterRule
methods.description: Handles entering a parse rule node during traversal.

methods.name: ExitRule
methods.description: Handles exiting a parse rule node during traversal.
